source.title: How Slum Redevelopment Is Changing Mumbai
source.description:
Slum rehabilitation is changing Mumbai’s skyline. With 40+ storey towers being built in places where dense settlements once stood.

But this isn’t just about construction. It’s about creating a potential win-win model for residents, developers and the city.

source_evidence_points: Vertical consolidation of ground footprints unlocks scarce, high-value prime urban land.
Cross-subsidization mechanics convert low-density obsolete structures into high-yielding commercial/residential density.
Urban infill redevelopment creates spatial equity, offering identical micro-location advantages to surrounding premium real estate.
pack.source_script_insight: The video highlights how vertical density clears horizontal land footprints, cross-subsidizing new developments while capturing prime location benefits without expansion into distant fringes.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In core Coimbatore zones like Town Hall, Gandhipuram, and RS Puram, vacant land is nearly non-existent. Smart investors look at old low-density structures ripe for vertical redevelopment and infill cross-subsidization rather than distant suburban sprawl.
pack.visual_strategy: Focus strictly on urban density transitions: tight old street footprints, structural clearing, high-density infill verticality, architectural blueprint comparison, and commercial corridor valuation. Avoid generic suburban land plots or happy family montages.
pack.core_takeaway: True urban value in central Coimbatore lies in redeveloping obsolete low-density land into high-density commercial/residential assets.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK
- Duration: EXACTLY 10.0 seconds total.
- Aspect Ratio: Native Portrait 9:16 vertical video.
- Audience Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.
- Visual Style: Hyper-realistic 4K digital cinematography, documentary film look, natural lighting, true color grading.

B. REALISM LOCK
- Must look like photorealistic physical-world video footage shot on a professional digital Cinema Camera (35mm lens, natural depth of field) or high-end camera drone in Coimbatore.
- NO animation, 2D/3D visual effects, CGI explainer elements, architectural renders, or fake digital overlays.
- Authentic urban settings, local architecture, concrete textures, realistic Tamil Nadu road traffic, authentic South Indian natural sunlight and evening ambient lighting.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK
- Primary Subject: Urban Redevelopment Mechanics & Infill Value Creation.
- Source Insights: 1. Clearing low-density obsolete horizontal structures frees prime urban footprint. 2. Vertical consolidation creates high-yielding density. 3. Urban infill captures top micro-location value without suburban risk.
- Coimbatore Application: Urban infill strategy for tight core nodes (Gandhipuram, RS Puram, Trichy Road) where raw land is fully depleted.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY
- Focus exclusively on structural transformation, footprint optimization, modern vertical replacement, and high-value urban corridor views.
- FORBIDDEN: Generic empty land plots, happy families standing on empty grass, generic construction site workers doing random labor, architectural 3D walk-throughs, or generic end cards.

E. CAMERA + IMAGE QUALITY
- Handheld real-world steady camera movements, subtle macro tilts, natural drone glides.
- Realistic optical lens characteristics: natural lens flares, minor motion blur, sharp focus on physical subject materials.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT PLAN (10.0 SECONDS TOTAL)

Shot 1 (0.0s - 1.4s):
- Location: Congested commercial street, Gandhipuram, Coimbatore.
- Framing: Eye-level vertical framing showing old brick/concrete shopfronts, overhead electric cables, motorbikes parked, dense urban context.
- Camera Movement: Slow steady forward push.
- Text Overlay: "இடம் இல்லையா?"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "நகர மையத்தில் இடம் கிடைக்கவில்லையா?"

Shot 2 (1.4s - 2.8s):
- Location: Modern office desk overlooking Coimbatore city street.
- Framing: Top-down shot of hands holding a crisp tablet showing a satellite urban density map of Coimbatore core.
- Camera Movement: Static macro focus on hands and screen.
- Text Overlay: "நில மறுபயன்பாடு"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "பழைய மனைகளை..."

Shot 3 (2.8s - 4.2s):
- Location: Urban infill redevelopment site in Coimbatore.
- Framing: Ground-level medium shot of an excavator bucket cleanly lifting concrete rubble of an old obsolete low-rise structure.
- Camera Movement: Static side profile.
- Text Overlay: "மறுவளர்ச்சி"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "...மறுவளர்ச்சி செய்வதே..."

Shot 4 (4.2s - 5.6s):
- Location: Trichy Road commercial corridor, Coimbatore.
- Framing: Low-angle upward shot of a modern 7-storey glass and composite panel commercial building façade under natural daylight.
- Camera Movement: Slow upward tilt.
- Text Overlay: "உயர்ந்த மதிப்பு"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "...உயர்ந்த நில மதிப்பை..."

Shot 5 (5.6s - 7.0s):
- Location: Upper floor interior balcony of a redeveloped building near Lakshmi Mills junction, Coimbatore.
- Framing: Over-the-shoulder view looking out over the sleek flyover and flowing street traffic.
- Camera Movement: Gentle pan right.
- Text Overlay: "அமைவிட பலன்"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "...வெளிக்கொணரும் சாவியாகும்!"

Shot 6 (7.0s - 8.5s):
- Location: Office interior with window view of Coimbatore skyline.
- Framing: Close-up shot of a hand holding a printed property yield report highlighting high commercial occupancy numbers.
- Camera Movement: Subtle handheld micro-adjust.
- Text Overlay: "வளர்ச்சி வாய்ப்பு"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "கோவையின் நகர மாற்றத்தில்..."

Shot 7 (8.5s - 10.0s):
- Location: Avinashi Road arterial stretch, Coimbatore.
- Framing: High-angle drone shot at dusk showing long exposure taillights, modern redeveloped commercial buildings, crisp evening air.
- Camera Movement: Slow back-and-up tracking shot.
- Text Overlay: "OliveTree Investors"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "...சரியாக முதலீடு செய்யுங்கள்!"

G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT
- Minimalist white sans-serif text overlays positioned cleanly at the lower-third, maximum 2-3 words per scene.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE
- Concludes on Shot 7 with real cityscape footage and a small, elegant text banner for OliveTree Investors on screen.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT / FIXED RULES
- DO NOT render 2D/3D animation, cartoon characters, fictional architectural renders, floating digital graphic houses, artificial CGI lighting, wide fisheye distortions, or speed ramps.
- DO NOT feature generic happy family home-buying scenes, generic construction safety helmet stock shots, or landscape videos framed inside portrait bars.
- DO NOT place text outside the 9:16 safe vertical area.
